notes: compensation runs the back-EMF speed estimate w = (V_mean - R (i_crest - Delta) - V_b(w, mech dir)) / Ke, solved by fixed point, through stage 2's mg90-b captures from the board's own signals and grades it against the ripple tach. headline: by V_b form (power, table), capture and speed band, each variant (none, delta, vb, both) as mean and rms in % of the tach and in rev/s; capture-1 is scored by the fold that left its repeat out of V_b, with Delta at G fitted on the meter runs only; swapped-1 and speed-torque are scored on capture-1's V_b and the published grid and were never in a fit; in_sample_published is capture-1 on motor-model's V_b and grid. identified: the same estimate, V_b as the table, both compensations, per pass tag (A reference constants, B reference R, Ke, Delta with V_b from one repeat's 7.4 V 30/40/60 % over 50 ms, C every constant identified, B+X one identified constant in B), the median pass with the rms range over the passes as bounds. r_of_t: all-band rms with R fixed, by the board NTC, and with the self-heat bound. vb_subsets: identification's V_b subsets scored like B, the median pass with its range, holds if within 0.2 points of A on every set. delta_f_ma_per_v: the published no-meter grid per volt, the rail mean with the rails' range. g_spin_ms: G by run left out. v_b: the fits by mechanical direction and capture-1's speed table. direction_mapping, v_b_between_sittings, delta_vs_dmm_ma, delta_vs_coast_ma, e0_truth_pct, r_sensitivity_pct and budget_rev_s as the notebook states them.
